meta.title: Lumina Alpine Retreat - Luxury Eco-Resort in the Dolomites
meta.description: Experience unparalleled luxury in the heart of the Italian Dolomites. Premium eco-resort featuring world-class spa, Michelin-starred dining, and exclusive alpine adventures.

backgroundImage.alt: Dramatic view of snow-capped Dolomites peaks at golden hour with luxury alpine resort nestled in the valley

data.title: Where Mountains
data.description: Discover unparalleled luxury nestled in the heart of the Italian Dolomites. Experience world-class hospitality, pristine alpine beauty, and sustainable luxury that respects the natural environment.

highlights.title: World-Class Spa
highlights.description: Rejuvenate your body and soul with our award-winning wellness treatments inspired by Alpine traditions.

image.alt: Serene spa treatment room with mountain views and natural stone elements

highlights.title: Elite Skiing Access
highlights.description: Direct access to pristine Dolomiti Superski slopes with private ski concierge service.

image.alt: Ski slopes with dramatic Dolomites mountain peaks in golden morning light

highlights.title: Michelin-Starred Cuisine
highlights.description: Savor exceptional culinary artistry featuring locally-sourced Alpine ingredients.

image.alt: Elegant fine dining setup with mountain view backdrop and artisanal presentation

highlights.title: Eco-Luxury Pioneer
highlights.description: Leading sustainable hospitality with carbon-neutral operations and local community partnerships.

image.alt: Modern eco-friendly architecture integrated harmoniously with alpine forest surroundings

testimonials.quote: Lumina Alpine Retreat exceeded every expectation. The perfect blend of luxury, sustainability, and genuine Alpine hospitality. Our suite overlooked pristine peaks, and every meal was a culinary masterpiece.
testimonials.author: Charlotte Dubois

testimonials.quote: The spa treatments here are transformative. The Alpine Stone Ritual combined with the mountain air created the most relaxing experience of my life. I left feeling completely rejuvenated.
testimonials.author: Marcus Weber

testimonials.quote: As someone passionate about sustainable travel, I was impressed by their genuine commitment to environmental responsibility without compromising on luxury. The perfect eco-conscious getaway.
testimonials.author: Isabella Rodriguez
